tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground: the chat thread, main content area, editor canvas. Bottom rung of the surface ladder.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Second rung: sidebar, top bar, tiles, inputs, modals, toasts. Most controls sit on it.

tokens.name: surface-elevated
tokens.usage: Third rung: hover state of tiles and nav items, peer chat bubbles, select options. Elevation reads as this step, not as a shadow.

tokens.name: surface-tool
tokens.usage: Tool-call messages in the chat thread. Same value as surface-elevated today; kept as its own role.

tokens.name: surface-translucent
tokens.usage: Assistant message wash and table zebra rows over bg. A 3% ink tint, never a solid fill.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Default 1px hairline between panels and around tiles, inputs, modals and toasts.

tokens.name: border-hover
tokens.usage: Hairline on hover for tiles and outlined buttons.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Checkbox and toggle-off outlines, API-key eye button hover. Clears 3:1 as a control boundary.

tokens.name: fg
tokens.usage: Primary text: headings, body prose, input values, tile names. Reads on bg, surface and surface-elevated.

tokens.name: fg-secondary
tokens.usage: Labels, ghost-button ink, nav items at rest, tile descriptions, section titles. Body AA on all three surfaces.

tokens.name: fg-tertiary
tokens.usage: Third text tier for supporting metadata. Body AA on all three surfaces.

tokens.name: fg-muted
tokens.usage: Hints, empty-state copy, tile mono meta, idle LED. Body AA on all three surfaces.

tokens.name: fg-faint
tokens.usage: DELIBERATE EXCEPTION, 3.0–4.5:1 band: telemetry eyebrows (in: / out: / ctx:) and message attribution only. Never prose, never an interactive affordance.

tokens.name: fg-on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and checkmarks on an accent fill (primary button, checked checkbox, toggle thumb).

tokens.name: fg-on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on a solid danger fill (armed Confirm Delete? button).

tokens.name: fg-tool-msg
tokens.usage: Monospace text of tool-call messages on surface-tool.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Violet. Interactive and selected states ONLY: primary button fill, focus ring, selected tab underline, active nav border, checked controls, links. Never decoration.

tokens.name: accent-api
tokens.usage: Badge tier, not interactive: marks a user message that arrived through the API instead of being typed by the operator.

tokens.name: accent-translucent
tokens.usage: Selected-state wash (active nav item, list item, chip) and the user chat bubble tint.

tokens.name: accent-translucent-hover
tokens.usage: Selected tile wash and the user bubble hairline; select option hover.

tokens.name: code-block-bg
tokens.usage: Code well for read-only code and prompts. One step below bg in dark, pale zinc in light.

tokens.name: code-block-fg
tokens.usage: Text inside the code well.

tokens.name: status-success
tokens.usage: Success ink and LED: connection test passed, model loaded. Always paired with a word.

tokens.name: status-warning
tokens.usage: Warning ink and LED: context nearing full, attention needed. Also the lapsed-confirmation outline.

tokens.name: status-warning-bg-soft
tokens.usage: Warning banner wash and quiet warning fills.

tokens.name: status-warning-bg-soft-2
tokens.usage: Stronger warning wash, the banner-warning gradient start.

tokens.name: status-warning-border
tokens.usage: Hairline around a warning fill.

tokens.name: status-danger
tokens.usage: Danger ink, invalid-field border, error toast, error banner, armed delete fill. Always paired with a word.

tokens.name: status-danger-muted
tokens.usage: Resting border of the danger button and resting ink of the list-item delete X.

tokens.name: status-danger-bg-soft
tokens.usage: Soft fill of the danger button and error banner.

tokens.name: badge-ollama

tokens.name: badge-openai-compatible
tokens.usage: Provider badge fill: OpenAI-compatible endpoints.

tokens.name: nav-bg
tokens.usage: Top bar and nav rail ground. Alias of surface: the rail is ladder-native, no palette island.

tokens.name: nav-bg-active
tokens.usage: Active nav row ground. Alias of surface-elevated.

tokens.name: nav-border
tokens.usage: Top bar bottom hairline. Alias of border.

tokens.name: nav-fg
tokens.usage: Area buttons at rest. Alias of fg-secondary.

tokens.name: nav-fg-hover
tokens.usage: Area buttons on hover. Alias of fg.

tokens.name: nav-fg-active
tokens.usage: Active area accent. Alias of accent.

tokens.name: sidebar-bg
tokens.usage: Sidebar ground. Alias of surface, so sidebar and rail read as one quiet surface.

families.family-mono: 'Geist Mono', 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Largest step. Rare: splash and hero moments only.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Top heading of a full-page view.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Page titles, editor titles and modal titles.

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Section headings inside editors (h2.section-title) and the top-bar wordmark (600).

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Replies read as prose at this size.
styles.usage: Chat messages, empty-canvas copy, modal message, tile names (600).

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Default UI text for inputs and toasts.
styles.usage: Inputs, selects, textareas, toasts, tiles. The UI chrome size.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Labels, buttons, nav items, tabs, descriptions, section titles (500).

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Leave blank to use the provider default.
styles.usage: Field hints, field errors, chips, telemetry.

styles.name: tiny
styles.usage: Badges and small buttons (btn-sm). Uppercase is allowed on badges only.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code wells, tool-call messages, tile meta, telemetry values (with tabular-nums).

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Entity-tile meta line and badge-slot text.

spacing.note: 4/8/12/16/24/32/48/64. Lay out siblings with gap, not margins.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Label-to-control gap in a field group; icon-to-text gap in tight rows.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons in a form-actions cluster; nav padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Field group bottom margin; section-title bottom margin.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Tile-grid gap; side gutter of the top bar; empty-canvas CTA offset.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Modal padding; section-title top margin between sibling sections.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Large section separation.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Page-level breathing room.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Largest step; hero and splash spacing.

radius.note: Small radii. The 12px step is reserved for blocking modals.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Controls: buttons, inputs, selects, list items, nav items, toasts, code wells, chat bubbles.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Tiles and cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Modal dialogs only. Distinguishes a blocking surface from inline ones.

shadow.note: Exactly two shadows. Anything else is expressed with the surface ladder and hairlines.

tokens.name: shadow-popover
tokens.usage: Toasts, dropdowns and other transient floats.

tokens.name: shadow-modal
tokens.usage: Modal dialogs. Nothing else.
